tools.description: Use to verify that ChatGPT can reach this Binnacle instance and to obtain bounded build, device, negotiated-protocol, reviewed-manifest, and visible- catalogue identities. Do not use for detailed system health or compatibility conclusions; use system_inspect or compatibility_report instead. Returns one normal-result envelope. It is read-only and may fail on authentication, unsupported revision, manifest mismatch, or unavailable device identity.
tools.name: binnacle_probe
tools.title: Probe Binnacle connectivity and identity

tools.description: Use for bounded read-only OS, kernel, architecture, uptime, CPU, memory, filesystem-summary, and Binnacle-service facts. Do not use for arbitrary file, process, network, package, or hardware inspection. Returns one normal-result envelope. It may fail when a requested section is unsupported or evidence cannot be collected within the read budget.
tools.name: system_inspect
tools.title: Inspect bounded Raspberry Pi system facts

tools.description: Use only during compatibility evaluation to exercise strings, numbers, arrays, nested objects, nulls, and warnings. Do not use as an operational data source. Returns deterministic normal-result test data and changes no device state.
tools.name: probe_result_formats
tools.title: Probe ChatGPT result-format handling

tools.description: Use only to test invalid input, policy rejection, known failure, timeout, uncertainty, or bounded delay. Do not use to diagnose real system failures. It creates no intentional device effect. Returns either the bounded-delay success envelope or a canonical execution-error envelope.
tools.name: probe_error
tools.title: Probe deterministic error presentation

tools.description: Use to read the sanitized empirical compatibility profile and its limitations. Do not infer support for an untested account, workspace, revision, or feature. The report excludes credentials, raw headers, private owner data, and reusable authority material, so its output is normal-result. It may report untested, blocked, unstable, or expired conclusions.
tools.name: compatibility_report
tools.title: Read sanitized ChatGPT compatibility evidence
